name: Sidebar
fit: A written system, read section by section.
layout: A left sidebar and a narrow reading column. This is the only sidebar template.
typography: A compact scale: title, section, body, and caption. Sidebar labels use the caption size.
fonts: Inter for title, section, body, and caption. JetBrains Mono for code, token names, and file paths.
icons: Lucide. panel-left marks the sidebar, book-open the brief, palette the design system, layers a feature, sun and moon the theme switch.
nav: Groups are Brief, Design system, and one group per feature. The current page is marked.
frames: Cases follow the writing. Light and dark sit side by side on wide screens.
chrome: Neutral light and dark for the docs chrome, separate from the product themes inside the frames.
adapt: Keep the sidebar groups and the caption labels. Keep the chrome neutral so it does not compete with the product. Pair with a font-pairings pick; recommend the pairing that lists this template.
